mechanism: Systemic absorption of prednisolone ophthalmic combined with bumetanide's potassium-wasting effect increases hypokalemia and hyperglycemia risk; corticosteroids may antagonize loop diuretic efficacy.
action: Monitor serum potassium, glucose, and blood pressure regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing diuretic; ensure adequate duration between ophthalmic administration and other medications.
